tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the 30 home repair trades Roger books in the United States and Canada.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Check whether Roger serves a ZIP or postal code, and whether a vetted pro for the trade is available there right now.

tools.name: get_estimate
tools.description: Get the estimated price range Roger shows for this problem at this location. Does not create a request.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Sends a homeowner repair request to Roger, which matches one vetted local pro. Returns a confirm_url where the homeowner confirms and books on rogerrepair.com. Requires homeowner_confirmed=true. Emails at example.com run in test mode: nothing is saved.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check where a Roger repair request stands, using the request_id from request_booking.
